page.overview:
What is Space Shuttle Endeavour Sets?

The Space Shuttle Endeavour Sets are a series of fourteen exclusive LEGO sets that were launched into space aboard the Space Shuttle Endeavour on May 16th, 2011.

The official information on the sets reveals that the astronauts aboard the ISS are going to: "Explore the effects of microgravity on simple machines by building models, conducting experiments, and sharing those results with students and teachers back on Earth through video and crew commentary.”. Meanwhile, select teachers and students on Earth will build the sets and conduct the same experiments and compare their results with those from the ISS.

The minifigures introduced in this theme are:
